description: District Energy Model (DEM) Input Data for Switzerland is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Ueli Schilt (Lucerne University of Applied Sciences and Arts). This repository provides input data for Switzerland used in the District Energy Model (DEM). The datasets were collected from various publicly available sources, pre-processed, and formatted for direct use within the DEM environment. Documentation of the model is available on Read The Docs. Coverage: national (CH); the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
